claims.assertion: Yazhi says astral experience is subjective, while shared astral realms form through overlapping perceptions and agreements; physical and astral worlds generate each other.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She describes the astral as a different frequency rather than a separate place.

claims.assertion: Yazhi describes organized astral factions competing for control of the physical world and human creative attention, with fear and suffering among the resources they exploit.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says the conflict has multiple layers and she does not know the full astral picture.
